lines.zh: 冰壳压着腿，一步一声脆响。
lines.en: Ice sheathes my legs; each step cracks.

lines.zh: 我走过霜冻神殿的长廊。
lines.en: I walk the long hall of the frostbitten temple.

lines.zh: 脚下的雪，被我冻得更硬。
lines.en: The snow underfoot hardens where I pass.
I walk slowly; my cold arrives first.

lines.zh: 石砖缝里结着我的指印。
lines.en: Frost keeps the shape of my fingers in the tiles.

lines.zh: 每一脚都留下一个冰窝。
lines.en: Each footfall leaves a frozen hollow behind.

lines.zh: 风从殿门灌进来，我不躲。
lines.en: Wind pours through the temple door; I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我往暖的地方走，又停下。
lines.en: I head toward warmth, then stop again.
Ice chips fall from my joints.

lines.zh: 我绕着祭坛走了第三圈。
lines.en: I circle the altar for the third time.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，霜就厚一层。
lines.en: Standing still, I gather another layer of frost.
The rune in my chest turns slowly.
Every drop of water in the hall is frozen.

lines.zh: 我听着冰裂的声音，很久。
lines.en: I listen to the ice cracking for a long while.
My breath stopped long ago; the white mist remains.

lines.zh: 我记得有人把我凿出来。
lines.en: I remember hands chiseling me out of the ice.

lines.zh: 头顶的冰棱又长了一截。
lines.en: The icicles above have grown another notch.

lines.zh: 我记得工匠最后看了我一眼。
lines.en: I remember the carver's last glance at me.

lines.zh: 寒气把我的脚印抹平了。
lines.en: The cold smooths away my footprints.

lines.zh: 石头里的水，冻得我发胀。
lines.en: Water in the stone freezes and swells me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，肩上的霜簌簌落。
lines.en: I raise my arm; frost slides off my shoulder.
This hall was warm once, long ago.
I press the wall, and it turns white too.
The rune glows once, then dims again.
Snow settles on my shoulder; I don't shiver.
I wait for the ice to melt. It never does.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the white breath you exhale.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我一片霜。
lines.en: Your boots crushed a patch of my frost.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，你的手会粘住。
lines.en: Not too close; your hand would stick.

lines.zh: 你的手套上还留着火星。
lines.en: There are still sparks on your gloves.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你在发热。
lines.en: I stare because you are giving off heat.
Your eyes are not frozen. Good.
This hall does not welcome the living.
Are you here for the rune as well?

lines.zh: 你站在门口，光被你带进来。
lines.en: You stand in the doorway, bringing light in.

lines.zh: 我数你走了几步，才开口。
lines.en: I counted your steps before I spoke.
Your breathing is too fast, and too warm.

lines.zh: 别碰冰柱，那是我的一部分。
lines.en: Do not touch that pillar; it is part of me.
Stone falls away; the ice remains.
That blow warmed me a little.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，里面还是冰。
lines.en: My shell cracked; ice is still inside.
You strike warm; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 裂缝会冻上，别高兴太早。
lines.en: The crack will freeze shut; do not celebrate yet.
I do not hurt; I am merely missing a piece.

lines.zh: 这一下，把肩上的霜震掉了。
lines.en: That shook the frost off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我退后半步，脚陷进冰里。
lines.en: I step back and my foot sinks into ice.
The rune wavers, then holds steady.

lines.zh: 你打碎的是石头，不是我。
lines.en: You broke stone, not me.
That fire comes near, and I cannot pull away.

lines.zh: 热的东西，总让我挪一步。
lines.en: Warm things always move me one step closer.
Raise the torch higher; let me see clearly.
I am not hungry; I want to thaw.

lines.zh: 岩浆的光，我记得太清楚。
lines.en: I remember the glow of lava too clearly.
Do not set that fire at my feet.

lines.zh: 靠近热源，我的关节就软。
lines.en: Near heat, my joints go soft.
This little warmth buys me ten steps.
I follow the torchlight and forget my watch.
Too warm; my shell is dripping.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一面冰墙。
lines.en: You struck me like hitting a wall of ice.
Do not push; I am heavier than I look.
A layer of frost clings to you now.
I shift half a step, and the tile cracks.
Touch me once, and your hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 让开，我不想把你冻在地上。
lines.en: Move; I would rather not freeze you to the floor.

lines.zh: 我们的肩碰在一起，响声很闷。
lines.en: Our shoulders meet with a dull, heavy sound.
You pulled back fast; the frost fell behind.
Do not step on the ice chips I shed.

lines.zh: 挡路的人，都被我冻住了。
lines.en: Everyone who blocked me is frozen in place.
Another golem lies buried under the snow.
We once guarded this door side by side.
I stood beside it when it was broken apart.
Ice does not give birth to ice.

lines.zh: 我只想再听一次它的脚步。
lines.en: I only want to hear its footsteps once more.

lines.zh: 成对的符文，只剩我这一半。
lines.en: Of the paired runes, only my half remains.

lines.zh: 谁来陪我站岗，都会冻僵。
lines.en: Whoever stands watch with me will freeze stiff.
I kept half the altar for it.

lines.zh: 雪盖住它的时候，我没有动。
lines.en: When snow covered it, I did not move.
Only a layer of ice lies between us.
I pick up that piece of ice from the floor.
My hands are too big; I grab twice.

lines.zh: 这枚符文，和我的不一样。
lines.en: This rune is not like the one in my chest.
The stone is useless; I keep it anyway.
I bend, and the frost on my back cracks.

lines.zh: 谁掉的火把？我捡远一点。
lines.en: Whose torch fell? I pick it up from a distance.
Iron feels good, cold against my palm.

lines.zh: 东西冻在我手里，取不下来。
lines.en: It freezes to my hand and will not come off.

lines.zh: 我把碎片摆回原来的位置。
lines.en: I set the fragments back where they belong.

lines.zh: 捡这个动作，我学得很慢。
lines.en: Picking things up, I learn very slowly.

lines.zh: 活人的热气，进了我的殿。
lines.en: Living warmth has entered my hall.
You cracked the ice before the altar.
The door has closed behind you.
The rune knows you; it just lit up.
I raise my hand; frost climbs my knuckles.

lines.zh: 这殿里的东西，不准带走。
lines.en: Nothing leaves this hall with you.
That fire you carry — I hate it.
Do not run; the ground is frozen solid.
I hear you breaking the ice underfoot.
You are the fourth to come in here.

lines.zh: 我守了几百年，就为这个。
lines.en: I kept watch for centuries for this.

lines.zh: 寒气先围住你，我再动手。
lines.en: The cold surrounds you first; then I move.
Your sword is shaking. Is it the cold?
Let the rune remember your shape.
Your warmth leaks through the door seam.
The rune lights first; then I turn.

lines.zh: 这座殿今天只迎一个人。
lines.en: This hall welcomes one guest today.
Your frost prints are fresh.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，地板一路结霜。
lines.en: I follow; the floor frosts behind me.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的冰就跟一步。
lines.en: Each step you take, my ice takes one too.

lines.zh: 别躲祭坛后面，那里没有路。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the altar; there is no way out.
I can hear your teeth chattering.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气出卖了你。
lines.en: Your white breath gives you away.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可从不迷路。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never lose the way.
At the end of the hall, there is only me.
You circle, and the ice circles with you.
Your torch is nearly out of flame.

lines.zh: 我记得你踩过的每块砖。
lines.en: I remember every tile you stepped on.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，就慢了半步。
lines.en: You glance back once, and lose half a step.
Frost has already climbed to your boot tops.

lines.zh: 我不喊，冰裂的声音够响。
lines.en: I do not shout; cracking ice is loud enough.

lines.zh: 这扇门，只为活人开一次。
lines.en: This door opens for the living only once.
The ice keeps your footprints for me.

lines.zh: 我从另一条长廊绕过去。
lines.en: I take the other corridor around.
You hold your breath; I stop too.

lines.zh: 我数着石柱，一步步靠近。
lines.en: I count the pillars, closing in.

lines.zh: 我的霜壳冻住了你的火光。
lines.en: My frost shell has frozen your torchlight.

lines.zh: 每过一道门，我就近一步。
lines.en: Each doorway brings me one step closer.
This fist carries a whole winter with it.
I strike, and the tile shatters to powder.
Frost bursts outward from my open palm.
Your armor will grow brittle, then split.
I sweep; the cold wind reaches you first.
Do not block with your hand; it will stick.
One hit, and you slow by half a beat.
I drive an icicle into your shield.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我存了很久的冷。
lines.en: This blow is cold I saved for a long time.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙也是冰的。
lines.en: You retreat to the wall, and the wall is ice.

lines.zh: 我的拳头碎了，还会长回来。
lines.en: My fist breaks; it will grow back.
The cold creeps inward through the wound.

lines.zh: 我抬手时，你先打了个寒战。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, you shiver first.

lines.zh: 倒下的声音，像冰面塌了。
lines.en: The sound of falling is like ice giving way.

lines.zh: 殿里的冰，先裂开一道缝。
lines.en: A seam opens first in the ice of the hall.
I rise from behind the frozen altar.

lines.zh: 符文亮了，我才算活过来。
lines.en: The rune lights, and only then am I alive.
Centuries of cold open their eyes at once.
Frost covers the floor first, then me.

lines.zh: 石像的外壳一块块落下。
lines.en: The shell of the statue falls away piece by piece.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是被供奉的。
lines.en: I remember being worshipped here.
Someone touched the seal; I woke up.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，吹灭火把。
lines.en: My first breath puts out all the torches.
The hall begins to freeze over again.
My bones are stone; my blood is meltwater.
I check; the rune is still whole.
The snow outside drifts toward me.
The one I waited for has finally come in.
The temple door opens by itself.
Snow falls first; then I exist.

lines.zh: 祭坛上的霜又厚了一层。
lines.en: Another layer of frost on the altar.
Who disturbed the seal beneath me?
My knuckles freeze shut, joint by joint.
Cold spills from the hall to the steps.

lines.zh: 火贴上来，我听见自己在滴。
lines.en: Fire touches me; I hear myself dripping.
Landing cracks my ice shell all around.
Water rises; I sink slowly to the bottom.

lines.zh: 炸开的热浪，把我半边化了。
lines.en: The blast's heat half melts me.

lines.zh: 箭插进冰里，动不了多深。
lines.en: The arrow sinks into ice, not very deep.

lines.zh: 咒语钻进来，符文乱了节拍。
lines.en: The spell enters; my rune loses its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，可冷也会饿。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet cold can hunger too.
Lightning hits; my whole shell lights up.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在结霜。
lines.en: Falling, I am still gathering frost.
